title: Infra — Mesh Security & Identity
description: OPERATIONAL_CONTRACT: Is mTLS identity exchange working across the mesh, and are certificates expiring? | METRICS_DEPENDENCY: [istio_mtls_handshake_errors_total, istio_cert_chain_expiry_timestamp] | METRICS_SOURCE: Istio control plane (istiod) | BREAKS_IF: Istio undeployed OR istiod stops exporting metrics | OWNER: Infrastructure SRE | Last validated: 2026-02-09. Panels render only where underlying metrics are present; empty panels indicate intentionally uninstrumented components.

panels.title: mTLS Handshake Failures
panels.description:
This metric is not emitted unless failures occur. 'No data' indicates a healthy system.
PANEL_CONTRACT: mTLS handshake failures observed | METRIC: istio_mtls_handshake_errors_total | NOTE: No data = no failures or exporter missing

panels.title: Certificate Expiry (days remaining)
panels.description:
This metric is not emitted unless cert-exporter is present. 'No data' indicates the exporter is not present or no expiry events were found.
PANEL_CONTRACT: Certificate expiry (days remaining) | METRIC: avg(istio_cert_chain_expiry_timestamp) | NOTE: No data = exporter missing
